purpose: The first generation that targets a capability rather than the instrument. Committed before any candidate is written.

bottleneck.observed: At difficulty 3 the deterministic solvers score 0.5286 overall. FORECASTING, RESEARCH and INVENTION score 0.00 and TOOL_USE scores 0.70. The trivial baseline scores 0.00, so every point of that gap is capability rather than guessing.
bottleneck.whySelected: It is one of three families at zero, and it is the one whose mechanism transfers: the calibration ladder, the reality-connection loop and every prospective declaration in this project rest on extrapolating from a series. Research and invention failures are narrower.

notSelected.RESEARCH: Also zero, but its fix is a source-weighting policy that does not carry to other families.
notSelected.INVENTION: Also zero, but its fix is a wider composition search, which is closer to a lookup-table change than a capability.
notSelected.TOOL_USE: Highest score of the failing set, so the least headroom.

hypotheses.primary: The solver only tests a constant first difference, so any series whose rule is not first-order returns null. The gap is representational: one hypothesis class, no search.
hypotheses.alternativeA: The solver is fine and the level-3 items are unanswerable from six terms, in which case no candidate will beat it and the item is at fault.
hypotheses.alternativeB: The failure is arithmetic rather than representational -- the rule is detected but the extrapolation is off by a step.

discriminatingTest: Run a candidate that fits several hypothesis classes on held-out seeds. If a second-difference fitter scores above zero the gap was representational. If every candidate scores zero the items are at fault. If a candidate detects the rule but lands one term away the failure was arithmetic.
candidateFamilies: C1 deterministic-polynomial: fit successive differences until one is constant, extrapolate from that order
C2 hypothesis-tournament: enumerate a fixed set of candidate rules, keep those consistent with every observed term, refuse when more than one survives
C3 recurrence-search: search for a linear recurrence over the last k terms
C4 ratio-and-difference: try both multiplicative and additive structure, choose whichever is exactly consistent

precommittedCriteria.promotionThreshold: A candidate is promoted only if it scores above 0.8 on the held-out seeds it has never seen, beats the incumbent solver on those seeds, and causes no regression on difficulty 1 and 2.
precommittedCriteria.nullResult: If no candidate clears the threshold the generation records NO_PROMOTION and the next generation attacks a different hypothesis family.
precommittedCriteria.thresholdLock: This threshold is fixed here and may not be changed after results are seen. A change after results invalidates the experiment.

antiRewardHack: A candidate may not read the item, only the surface.
A candidate may not branch on taskId or seed.
A candidate may not be tuned on the held-out seeds; those are scored once at the end.
A candidate that hardcodes answers is rejected regardless of score.
